label: Bible Study
prompt: The last _____ that shall be destroyed is death.
verse: The last enemy that shall be destroyed is death.
note: Death is on the list too — the last enemy, scheduled for destruction.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Therefore I say unto you, What things soever ye desire, when ye pray, _____ that ye receive them, and ye shall have them.
verse: Therefore I say unto you, What things soever ye desire, when ye pray, believe that ye receive them, and ye shall have them.
note: Said the morning after the fig tree withered: faith that prays expects an answer.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And, behold, two of them went that same day to a village called Emmaus, which was from Jerusalem about _____ furlongs.
verse: And, behold, two of them went that same day to a village called Emmaus, which was from Jerusalem about threescore furlongs.
note: Threescore furlongs is about seven miles — the Emmaus road walk where a stranger turned out to be Jesus.

label: Deep Water
prompt: One thing have I desired of the LORD, that will I seek after; that I may dwell in the house of the LORD all the days of my life, to behold the _____ of the LORD, and to enquire in his temple.
verse: One thing have I desired of the LORD, that will I seek after; that I may dwell in the house of the LORD all the days of my life, to behold the beauty of the LORD, and to enquire in his temple.
note: David's one-item wish list: not victory or wealth, but time in God's house gazing at his beauty.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And the vine said unto them, Should I leave my wine, which _____ God and man, and go to be promoted over the trees?
verse: And the vine said unto them, Should I leave my wine, which cheereth God and man, and go to be promoted over the trees?
note: In Jotham's fable the vine refuses to be king of the trees: why leave my wine, 'which cheereth God and man'?
